chapterTitle: Chapter 21 Carboxylic Acid Derivatives: Nucleophilic Acyl Substitution Reactions
title: Problem 21-21

pages.text: PROBLEM 21-21 How would you use the reaction of an amide with LiAlH4 as the key step in going from bromocyclohexane to (N,N-dimethylaminomethyl)cyclohexane? Write all the steps in the reaction sequence.
